{{Youmay|the body part|the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as [[The Throat]]}}
[[File:NihlForceChoke.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Cade Skywalker]], clutching his throat while being [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Nihl|Nihl]].]]

The '''throat''' was part of the [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] anatomy, the anterior part of the neck. A throat consisted of a [[trachea]] and a [[Larynx/Legends|larynx]]. A [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Choke]] was focused here to punish, or more often than not (in the case of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]), to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a target.

[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] had four throats in a [[throat sack]].
